summary.text: Mitchell Horner is a Republican state representative from Georgia House District 3 who has served since 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Horner assumed office in the Georgia House on January 9, 2023, and advanced from the Republican primary on May 19, 2026.

For 2025-2026 he was assigned to the House Retirement Committee, the Small Business Development Committee and the House Transportation Committee, and he is vice chair of the Budget and Fiscal Affairs Oversight Committee.
